spawnoverlay.configuration.alwaysSpawnin: The hex color (with alpha) used to show positions mobs can spawn regardless of time (Default: #228B22B3 (4D = 30% opacity))
spawnoverlay.configuration.chunkRadius.t: The radius of chunks to display the overlay (Default: 3)
spawnoverlay.configuration.ignorePeacefu: Ignore peaceful biomes when displaying the overlay (Default: true)
spawnoverlay.configuration.nightSpawning: The hex color (with alpha) used to show positions mobs can spawn at night (Default: #780606B3 (4D = 30% opacity))
spawnoverlay.configuration.optimizerColo: The hex color (with alpha) used to show where to place slabs (Default: #808080B3 (4D = 30% opacity))
spawnoverlay.configuration.optimizerType: The type of slab optimizer to use (Default: SPIDER)
spawnoverlay.configuration.overlayType.t: The type of overlay to display (Default: OUTLINE)
spawnoverlay.configuration.phantomSpawni: The hex color (with alpha) used to show positions phantoms can spawn (Default: #3e5089B3 (4D = 30% opacity))
The interval in milliseconds between overlay updates (Default: 200)
spawnoverlay.configuration.preventSpawni: The hex color (with alpha) used to show positions where spawning is prevented (Default: #FFFFFFB3 (4D = 30% opacity))
spawnoverlay.configuration.showAlwaysSpa: Show positions mobs can spawn regardless of time (Default: false)
spawnoverlay.configuration.showNightSpaw: Show positions mobs can spawn at night (Default: true)
spawnoverlay.configuration.showPhantomSp: Show positions phantoms can spawn (Default: false)
spawnoverlay.configuration.showPreventSp: Show positions where spawning is prevented (Default: false)
